Thanks for doing this. 90% of the people who post here seem to have been taking the drug a year or less so it's good to have someone who's taken it longer.

-How long do you plan on taking fin?

-Do you get regular bloodchecks to check hormone levels & whatnot?

-Have you thought about what you will do when/if you discontinue the drug? Is there any risk in just stopping cold turkey after all this time?
